rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the current calendar day or date.

example.english: I have to go to work today.

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for referring to the current calendar day.

example.english: It's raining today, so I'm not going out.
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 lok6 jyu5 ngo5 m4 ceot1 gaai1

rows.note: Use this for the present era or these days, rather than for the specific calendar day.

example.english: People today really like paying by phone.
example.traditional: 而家啲人好鍾意用手機畀錢。
example.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 di1 jan4 hou2 zung1 ji3 jung6 sau2 gei1 bei2 cin2

rows.note: Use this for the present era or modern times rather than one particular calendar day.

example.english: People today really live at a fast pace.
example.traditional: 現代人生活節奏真係快。
example.jyutping: jin6 doi6 jan4 sang1 wut6 zit3 zau3 zan1 hai6 faai3
